strapiBlog.title: Property of the Week: Costa Mare by Ellington Properties
strapiBlog.short_description: A wave of excitement surrounded the launch of Burj Azizi with the sale of an astounding AED 63 million penthouse among the first properties to be claimed on day one.

data.text:
Costa Mare by Ellington Properties is an exceptional off-plan development redefining luxury coastal living in Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. This prestigious project offers an exclusive collection of residences, including apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and villas, all designed to provide an unparalleled beachfront lifestyle. With breathtaking sea views, innovative smart home technology, and direct beach access, Costa Mare represents the pinnacle of sophistication and comfort. A seamless blend of elegance and nature, this development is poised to become a landmark destination for discerning homeowners and investors alike.

Costa Mare by Ellington: A Detailed Review

Prime Location in Al Marjan Island

Costa Mare enjoys a prime location on Al Marjan Island, a rapidly emerging luxury destination in Ras Al Khaimah. This iconic island offers pristine beaches, world-class hospitality, and direct access to major road networks, ensuring seamless connectivity to Dubai and other key locations. With Ras Al Khaimah's tourism sector on the rise, Al Marjan Island is becoming a sought-after address for both investors and homeowners seeking an exclusive waterfront lifestyle.

Luxurious Property Options

Costa Mare offers an impressive selection of residences catering to various preferences and lifestyles. The development includes:

  • Apartments – 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units
  • Duplexes – 1, 2, and 3-bedroom layouts
  • Penthouses – Spacious 4-bedroom residences with panoramic sea views
  • Villas – Exclusive 5 and 6-bedroom beachfront homes

Each residence is meticulously designed with premium finishes, expansive living spaces, and floor-to-ceiling windows that capture the beauty of the Arabian Gulf. Whether you seek a stylish apartment or a private villa, Costa Mare delivers an unmatched standard of luxury.

Competitive Pricing and Flexible Payment Plan

Ellington Properties ensures that investing in Costa Mare is both accessible and rewarding. The project offers a 70/30 payment plan, allowing buyers to pay 70% during the construction phase and the remaining 30% upon handover. With completion expected in Q3 2028, investors have ample time to plan their finances while securing a high-value asset in a prime location.

Features and Amenities of Costa Mare Beachfront Apartments

Costa Mare is designed to provide an exceptional lifestyle with state-of-the-art amenities, including:

  • AI-powered smart living for enhanced convenience and security
  • Direct beach access, offering residents an exclusive waterfront experience
  • Panoramic sea views from every residence
  • Lush outdoor spaces, including lush landscapes, jogging trails, and serene waterfront spaces, promoting tranquility and relaxation
  • Five pools (indoor & outdoor) for ultimate leisure and wellness
  • A state-of-the-art wellness spa and Pilates studio for a holistic lifestyle
  • An exclusive clubhouse and private cinema for entertainment and social gatherings
  • Sky-hanging amenities, offering unique and breathtaking experiences

These premium features and amenities of Costa Mare beachfront apartments make it stand out as a premier choice for luxury living in Ras Al Khaimah.

Why Invest in Costa Mare in Al Marjan Island?

Developed by a Leading Real Estate Brand

Ellington Properties is known for its commitment to quality and innovation. As one of the most reputable developers in the UAE, the company ensures that Costa Mare meets the highest standards of design, sustainability, and functionality.

Prime Waterfront Location with High Growth Potential

Al Marjan Island is rapidly evolving into a premier lifestyle and investment destination. Its strategic location, coupled with the increasing demand for high-end waterfront properties, makes it a lucrative choice for investors seeking strong capital appreciation.

Excellent Connectivity

With easy access to major highways, Costa Mare ensures seamless connectivity to Dubai and other Emirates. Residents can enjoy a tranquil beachfront lifestyle while remaining well-connected to urban conveniences.

Flexible and Investor-Friendly Payment Plan

The 70/30 payment plan offers investors flexibility and ease of entry, making it an attractive option for those looking to capitalize on the growing demand for luxury properties in Ras Al Khaimah.

Strong Rental Demand and High Returns

With the increasing popularity of Ras Al Khaimah as a luxury tourism and residential hub, properties in Costa Mare are expected to generate higher rental yields compared to other developments in the region. The combination of exclusivity, location, and premium living experiences makes it a highly desirable rental asset.

Costa Mare presents an exceptional opportunity to own a luxury property in one of Ras Al Khaimah’s most prestigious waterfront locations. Buyers interested in this exclusive development can contact the experts at Zoya Ventures Real Estate for a seamless investment experience.

About Ellington Properties

Ellington Properties is a Dubai-based real estate developer renowned for crafting high-end residential communities that emphasize quality, aesthetics, and functionality. With a strong track record of delivering award-winning developments, Ellington is synonymous with excellence in the UAE’s real estate market.
